name: An American Tail: The Computer Adventures of Fievel and His Friends
summary: The player guides Fievel Mousekewitz to find and protect his family across two halves, based on the films An American Tail and An American Tail: Fievel Goes West. Whenever the mouse pointer is placed over an interactive element, the icon changes to indicate that an appropriate action will take place to correspond with that icon, such as talking to characters, picking up items, looking at objects and going to another location. When talking to a character, the player will have multiple dialogue responses to choose from. Clicking on Fievel himself allows the player to give one or more items from his inventory to a character on screen. Throughout the game, the player must win mini-games such as card matching, dots, a shell game and target shooting to gain required items, and most of them can be replayed as many times as it takes.
